decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (W1, W2 and Unnumbered Location Plan [received on 6 February 2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension to the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be in keeping with the existing outbuilding.

Condition : 5 - The detached single storey outbuilding must only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (e.g. it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, living room or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes).
description: Ererction of a single storey extension to the existing outbuilding.
